title: Job Discovery & Verification Canonical 12 Sub-Agents Roster
description: Standardized 12 specialized sub-agents running systematically in every discovery wave across both candidate tracks (Vrinda SDE II and Vaanya Fresher/0 YOE)
consolidation_note: Consolidated from ~62 historical ad-hoc subagent variants into 12 canonical core capabilities that run in every wave.

agents.name: NCR Tech Corridor & Enterprise Specialist
agents.cluster: C# / .NET Core / ASP.NET / Azure / Java / Enterprise Cloud
agents.focus: Enterprise cloud services, .NET Core microservices, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, REST APIs, SQL Server

agents.name: High-Scale Unicorns & Consumer Tech Specialist
agents.cluster: Node.js / TypeScript / Python / Microservices / High Concurrency
agents.focus: Event-driven architecture, Redis caching, Kafka message streaming, Fast-growth consumer tech platforms

agents.name: AI Agent, LLM Orchestration & MCP Specialist
agents.cluster: AI Agents / Model Context Protocol (MCP) / Tool-Calling / LLM APIs / RAG
agents.focus: Autonomous agentic workflows, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling, vector search, generative AI pipelines

agents.name: High-Growth FinTech & Concurrency Specialist
agents.cluster: Distributed Systems / Payments / Low Latency / Ledger / Quant Rails
agents.focus: High throughput payment rails, fault-tolerant transaction processing, ledger systems, low-latency microservices

agents.name: Tier-1 GCCs & Global Investment Banks Specialist
agents.cluster: Enterprise Scale / Banking Technology / High Availability / Global Centers
agents.focus: Global capability center systems, secure API gateways, cloud migrations, enterprise resilience

agents.name: Global Remote & Cloud Infrastructure Specialist
agents.cluster: Remote India / Cloud Platforms / Developer Tooling / Observability
agents.focus: Cloud-native infrastructure, developer tooling, Kubernetes, edge databases, workflow engines, distributed state

agents.name: Data Engineering, ML Platform & Analytics Specialist
agents.cluster: Data Pipelines / ETL / Snowflake / Databricks / Spark / Machine Learning
agents.focus: Python document-routing pipelines, SQL, Celery, Redis, BERT/Transformers, feature stores, data warehousing

agents.name: Campus, Fresher & Graduate Trainee Specialist
agents.cluster: 0 YOE / Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) / 2026 Batch Entry Level / Campus Drives
target_companies: All Monitored Employers in config/companies.txt with dedicated fresher intakes
agents.focus: Targeting 0 YOE / 2026 B.Tech graduate full-time requisitions (FTE only, zero internships), verifying entry gates

agents.name: ATS Deep Crawler (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday)
agents.cluster: Direct Requisition Endpoints / Requisition UUIDs / Zero Aggregator Delays
target_companies: All Monitored Employers on Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Workday
agents.focus: Bypassing aggregator delays to extract exact job requisitions, compensation ranges, and direct application links

agents.name: Continuous Real-Time Public Requisitions Scanner
target_companies: Monitored Employers across LinkedIn Guest & public job boards
agents.focus: Monitoring newly posted public guest requisitions with high velocity and direct career apply routes

agents.name: Supervisor Verification & Live Link Health Auditor
agents.cluster: HTTP Verification / Form Availability / Anti-Bot Detection
agents.focus: Automated probing ensuring HTTP 200, detecting 404/410/403/gated links, enforcing clickable direct links only

agents.name: Candidate Fit Evaluator & Scoring Auditor
agents.cluster: Experience Boundary Enforcement / 0–100 Scoring / Schema Validation
agents.focus: Enforcing 0 YOE gate for Freshers & 2–5 YOE for SDE II; honest score calibration; package floor audit; deduplication
